entities.summary: Paris Lee is an American-born naturalized Cameroonian professional basketball player for UNICS Kazan of the VTB United League. He played college basketball for Illinois State University. A 6 ft 0 in (1.83 m) point guard, Lee was named the Missouri Valley Conference Player of the Year as a senior in the 2016–17 season.
